summary: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on May 27, 2026. The meeting covered routine items: adoption of audited financial statements for the year ended December 31, 2025, ratification of a Long-Term Incentive Plan (limiting grants to 1% of issued Class A shares per year), re-election of eight directors (Luis Frias, Maria Judith de Brito, Eduardo Alcaro, et al.), and ratification of prior actions. No special-situation event such as M&A, buyback, tender offer, restructuring, delisting, or activist campaign was disclosed. This is a routine governance filing with no economic event for risk-arb or special-situations monitoring.
